title: Rutin alleviates LPS-induced injury in IPEC-J2 cells via suppression of ferroptosis: involvement of NFE2L2-KEAP1, TLR4 and ALOX5.
authors: Huo, LeLe; Liu, JunYing; Li, MengXuan; Tian, WanRu; Wang, BinBin; Cao, HanYang; Luo, Gang; Shen, ManMan; Liu, JiYing
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦丁对LPS诱导肠上皮细胞铁死亡的缓解作用，虽含分子对接但核心是细胞表型与基因表达，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced intestinal epithelial injury contributes to the loss of gut homeostasis. It is unknown whether ferroptosis is involved in this injury and whether rutin can attenuate ferroptosis-associated changes in porcine intestinal epithelial cells. In this in vitro study, IPEC-J2 cells were exposed to LPS (10 mug/mL) with or without rutin pretreatment (200 muM). LPS induced a ferroptosis-associated phenotype, including cell shrinkage and death, increased malondialdehyde, reactive oxygen species (ROS), and ferrous iron (Fe(2+)), upregulated PTGS2 and DMT1, and decreased GPX4, SLC7A11, and FTH1 expression. Rutin pretreatment reduced TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta expression, limited lipid peroxidation, ROS accumulation, and LPS-induced Fe(2+) overload, and partially restored GPX4 and FTH1 while reducing PTGS2. Integrated transcriptomic analysis, network pharmacology, and molecular docking identified NFE2L2, KEAP1, TLR4, and ALOX5 as candidate targets, and qRT-PCR showed that rutin reversed LPS-associated changes in these genes. These findings suggest that LPS-induced injury in IPEC-J2 cells is accompanied by ferroptosis-related changes and that rutin may attenuate this in vitro injury by coordinating antioxidant, inflammatory, iron-metabolism, and lipid-peroxidation-related gene responses. Further functional studies are needed to confirm direct target involvement and causal mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 脂多糖（LPS）诱导的肠道上皮损伤导致肠道稳态丧失。目前尚不清楚铁死亡是否参与该损伤，以及芦丁是否能减轻猪肠道上皮细胞中与铁死亡相关的变化。在本体外研究中，IPEC-J2细胞暴露于LPS（10 μg/mL），有或无芦丁预处理（200 μM）。LPS诱导了铁死亡相关表型，包括细胞皱缩和死亡、丙二醛、活性氧（ROS）和亚铁离子（Fe(2+)）增加、PTGS2和DMT1上调，以及GPX4、SLC7A11和FTH1表达下降。芦丁预处理降低了TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β的表达，限制了脂质过氧化、ROS积累和LPS诱导的Fe(2+)过载，并部分恢复了GPX4和FTH1，同时降低了PTGS2。整合转录组分析、网络药理学和分子对接确定了NFE2L2、KEAP1、TLR4和ALOX5为候选靶点，qRT-PCR显示芦丁逆转了LPS相关基因的变化。这些发现表明，LPS诱导的IPEC-J2细胞损伤伴随铁死亡相关变化，芦丁可能通过协调抗氧化、炎症、铁代谢和脂质过氧化相关基因反应来减轻该体外损伤。需要进一步的功能研究来确认直接靶点参与和因果机制。
